The Dubai Media Council concludes its visit to South Korea, led by Nehal Badri, Secretary General of the Dubai Media Council. The delegation included Mohamed Sulaiman Al Mulla, CEO of Dubai Media, alongside representatives from the Dubai Media Council, the Government of Dubai Media Office, Dubai Media, and the Dubai Film and Games Commission. The visit programme included 25 meetings covering media production, content distribution, talent development, films and series, as well as the development of the gaming industry and expanding its presence in global markets.
